I didn't think it was necessary since errors thrown in "in parallel" steps are already lost, right? It aborts the in parallel steps, but that's it.

I catch the errors here to prevent the loop ending. Although I note that the [event loop](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#event-loop-processing-model) doesn't do this, which I guess is a throwback from when errors had to be specifically rethrown.

Do you think it's worth adding a note like "Errors thrown from enqueued steps do not prevent other enqueued steps from running"?
